prompt:

Header text verbatim: "publicera". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "publish".
Scene: An adult author and publisher reviewing a finished book proof as identical finished books arrive on a display shelf, no readable title or personal names.

Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "De ska publicera hennes bok.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
